200.description: Authenticated session. Pending consent responses contain the CSRF token and expiration and set consent_required to true.

get.description: Read the current user agreement and privacy policy and this account’s consent for each. Authenticated business operations requiring current consent return HTTP 403 with code consent_required while either document is pending.

200.description: Current documents with separate status and receipt for each accepted version and digest.

post.description: Record the account’s explicit acceptance of one current document. The server validates the document identifier, version and digest and derives the account and source. A retry of the same current document version and digest returns its original receipt. An allowed browser Origin and the session CSRF token are required.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Allowed browser origin. Browsers supply this header automatically.

200.description: Current document statuses and the persisted receipt for the submitted document.

503.description: Current binding could not be verified

delete.description: Clear the current account phone and country code. Requires another usable sign-in method and SMS MFA disabled.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

upstream_ended.description: True only if Casdoor confirms the single end-session request within its deadline.

upstream_ended.description: True only if Casdoor confirms the single end-session request within its deadline.

302.description: Redirect to the configured OIDC issuer

400.description: invalid_input for an invalid or malformed provider; invalid_return_url for a return URL outside configured frontend origins

503.description: dependency_unavailable when QQ has no configured provider name or the login flow cannot be saved
